parts:
Hi all, 

Next week thursday, February 9th, we will read a paper about the package learnr and then try out learnr ourselves by following along with examples from the learnr vignette. It'll be a relaxed, low stress exploration of what can be done with this new package!

Also, while you are here, check out our schedule of events for the quarter: 
February 9: learnr paper and exploration - group 
February 16: Group watch of Responsible Data Science (10am - 12pm)
February 23: RStudio on the FARM - Reed
March 2: Web/Quarto - Liza
March 9: Mapmaking with falling fruit data - Reed + Tara
March 16: Apache Arrow for geospatial data - Ryan 
March 23: still looking for a presenter!

Best,
Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
